title: Topology-backed Runtime geometry
description: Share Topology placement, zone spacing, orthogonal routing, and design-only no-data semantics with Runtime.
completion_criteria: Runtime uses Topology golden-grid placement and zone clearance.
Runtime edges use component-safe orthogonal routes.
Unobserved authored nodes and edges remain visible as declared no-data structure.
Canvas, minimap, SVG, and PNG consume the same geometry.
Targeted tests, typecheck, and production build pass.
success_criteria: Runtime presents the complete authored system architecture.
Spacing and routing remain deterministic across Topology and Runtime.
Missing observations are explicit and never fabricated.
triage_notes: Runtime remains DSL-authored and connector-free. Topology is the geometry authority; Runtime adds operational state.
